summary.text: Kelabe Tewolde is a Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 37-Position 1, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An educator, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he has spent eight years working at Rainier Scholars and has served on the Seattle Planning Commission.

paragraphs.text: Kelabe Tewolde earned a bachelor's degree from Colgate University in 2019.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is the son of an Eritrean refugee and an alumnus of Rainier Scholars, and that he is a first-generation college student.
He said he graduated from Colgate with a degree in political science and interned in Senator Patty Murray's Seattle and Washington, D.C. offices.
Tewolde said he returned to Rainier Scholars as an educator and has spent the past eight years there as a teacher, advocate and mentor.
He said he served on the Seattle Planning Commission as Land Use and Transportation co-chair and organized mutual aid efforts in 2020.

Tewolde said his priorities include funding transition-to-kindergarten programs, early literacy supports and school behavioral health resources, establishing a youth development fund account, and restoring funding for the Education Legacy Trust Fund.
